question: Using data from both the regular season and the post-season, identify the pitcher who achieved the highest non-zero pitch speed for each team by confirming whether the pitcher’s ID appears in the relevant home or away player lists for that game, then retrieve that pitcher’s full name along with the maximum valid pitch speed they achieved while playing for that specific team.

WITH combined AS (
  SELECT gameId, pitcherId, pitcherFirstName, pitcherLastName, pitchSpeed, homeTeamId, homeTeamName, awayTeamId, awayTeamName, lineupTeamId, lineupPlayerId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.baseball.games_wide`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT gameId, pitcherId, pitcherFirstName, pitcherLastName, pitchSpeed, homeTeamId, homeTeamName, awayTeamId, awayTeamName, lineupTeamId, lineupPlayerId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.baseball.games_post_wide`
),
pitchers_on_teams AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.gameId, c.pitcherId, c.pitcherFirstName, c.pitcherLastName, c.pitchSpeed, c.homeTeamId AS teamId, c.homeTeamName AS teamName
  FROM combined c
  WHERE c.pitchSpeed > 0
    AND c.homeTeamName NOT IN ('American League', 'National League')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM combined c2 WHERE c2.gameId = c.gameId AND c2.lineupPlayerId = c.pitcherId AND c2.lineupTeamId = c.homeTeamId)
),
pitchers_on_teams_away AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.gameId, c.pitcherId, c.pitcherFirstName, c.pitcherLastName, c.pitchSpeed, c.awayTeamId AS teamId, c.awayTeamName AS teamName
  FROM combined c
  WHERE c.pitchSpeed > 0
    AND c.awayTeamName NOT IN ('American League', 'National League')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM combined c2 WHERE c2.gameId = c.gameId AND c2.lineupPlayerId = c.pitcherId AND c2.lineupTeamId = c.awayTeamId)
),
all_pitchers AS (
  SELECT teamId, teamName, pitcherId, pitcherFirstName, pitcherLastName, pitchSpeed FROM pitchers_on_teams
  UNION ALL
  SELECT teamId, teamName, pitcherId, pitcherFirstName, pitcherLastName, pitchSpeed FROM pitchers_on_teams_away
),
max_per_pitcher_team AS (
  SELECT teamId, teamName, pitcherId, pitcherFirstName, pitcherLastName, MAX(pitchSpeed) AS max_speed
  FROM all_pitchers
  GROUP BY teamId, teamName, pitcherId, pitcherFirstName, pitcherLastName
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT teamId, teamName, pitcherId, pitcherFirstName, pitcherLastName, max_speed,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY teamId ORDER BY max_speed DESC) AS rn
  FROM max_per_pitcher_team
)
SELECT teamId, teamName, pitcherId, pitcherFirstName, pitcherLastName, max_speed
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY teamName
